summary: Refactored the extension UI module by splitting PiExtensionUiStore.svelte.ts into a thin 182 LOC facade plus four cohesive modules (State, Events, Types, Collections), preserving runtime-scoped state, dialogs, queued answers, notifications, response errors, cleanup, subscriptions, and public API. Verified with prettier, Svelte autofixer (clean on the reactive state module), app check (0 errors/0 warnings), 8/8 extension UI tests passing, and a full app suite of 165 passed / 1 unrelated concurrent failure (App.test.ts missing 'Remove reference.png').
decisions: Reduced PiExtensionUiStore.svelte.ts to a stable public facade (~182 LOC) rather than splitting tests, since the related tests were already under 300 LOC.
errors: Full app suite had 1 failure in App.test.ts ('could not find Remove reference.png') that was determined to be an unrelated concurrent working-tree issue, not caused by this refactor.
